job.raw:
#!/bin/bash
#SBATCH --nodelist=hpc-02,hpc-03,hpc-04,hpc-05,hpc-07
#SBATCH --job-name=hpl-mkl
#SBATCH --nodes=5
#SBATCH --ntasks-per-node=16
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=1
#SBATCH --partition=batch
#SBATCH --time=02:30:00
#SBATCH --exclusive
#SBATCH --hint=nomultithread
#SBATCH --output=run.sh-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=run.sh-%j.err

# --- Intel oneAPI: MKL + Intel MPI ---
source /opt/intel/oneapi/setvars.sh 2>/dev/null

# MKL: single-threaded (pure MPI, 1 rank per core)
export MKL_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_DYNAMIC=FALSE
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export MKL_ENABLE_INSTRUCTIONS=AVX

# --- Intel MPI: TCP over Ethernet (confirmed working on this cluster) ---
# Intel MPI hydra bootstrap via SSH is used instead.
export I_MPI_FABRICS=shm:ofi
export I_MPI_OFI_PROVIDER=tcp
export I_MPI_TCP_NETMASK=192.168.2.0/24
export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP=ssh
export I_MPI_HYDRA_BOOTSTRAP_EXEC_EXTRA_ARGS="-o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o CheckHostIP=no -o BatchMode=yes"
export I_MPI_PIN=1
export I_MPI_PIN_DOMAIN=core
export I_MPI_PIN_ORDER=scatter
export I_MPI_DEBUG=1

# Ulimits
ulimit -l unlimited
ulimit -n 65536

# --- HPL binary (Intel MPI + MKL BLAS) on shared NFS ---
HPL_BIN=/opt/intel/hpl/xhpl

# Symlink so xhpl is accessible as ./xhpl in the job working directory
ln -sf "$HPL_BIN" ./xhpl

ldd "$HPL_BIN" | grep -E 'not found' && {
  echo "ERROR: missing shared libraries for xhpl on $(hostname)"; exit 1; }

echo "=== HPL MKL Benchmark ==="
echo "Nodes: $SLURM_JOB_NODELIST"
echo "Total ranks: $SLURM_NTASKS"
echo "Started: $(date)"
echo "HPL.dat: $(pwd)/HPL.dat"
echo "--- HPL.dat contents ---"
cat HPL.dat
echo "------------------------"

# Run HPL — Intel MPI launches 16 ranks/node across 5 nodes = 80 total.
mpirun -n "$SLURM_NTASKS" -ppn "$SLURM_NTASKS_PER_NODE" ./xhpl

echo "Finished: $(date)"
